description: oid4vci-demo-issuer HAIP conformance (oid4vci-1_0-issuer-haip-test-plan) against https://issuer.zkp.au -- requires the Cloudflare tunnel stack (docker-compose.tunnel.yml) to be running; see conformance/README.md

keys.d: <PLACEHOLDER -- private half of a fresh, throwaway P-256 test wallet key; never commit the real value>

credential.trust_anchor_pem:
-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
<PLACEHOLDER -- PEM of the throwaway root CA that issued demo-issuer-signing-key.p12's leaf cert (not the leaf itself -- the leaf alone is in the credential's own x5c, not the root; see DemoIssuerKeyConfig.java)>
-----END CERTIFICATE-----
credential.status_list_trust_anchor_pem:
-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
<PLACEHOLDER -- PEM of this issuer's status list signing trust anchor, if applicable>
-----END CERTIFICATE-----

keys.d: <PLACEHOLDER -- private half of the Wallet Provider attestation key. This project's own application.yml documents that this key's private half must never live in this repo -- keep it only in the real (gitignored) config, never here>
x5c: <PLACEHOLDER -- DER cert matching the checked-in client-attestation-trusted-issuer-key public JWK in oid4vci-demo-issuer/src/main/resources/application.yml>
